summary: Compile-time tonic/prost generated bindings for backbone proto3 write-service contracts.
claim_boundary: Generated binding seam only. This slice compiles source-controlled proto3 contracts into tonic/prost Rust message and service modules at build time with vendored protoc. It proves local prost binary encode/decode round trips for generated request types. It does not start a gRPC server/client, open network connections, deploy a gateway, publish broker messages, integrate databases, or certify production interoperability.

source_basis.use: Official tonic-build docs for using tonic-prost-build in build.rs, include_proto!, and the tonic/prost dependency shape.
Official tonic-prost-build docs for compile_protos/configure usage and transport feature boundary. Local cargo info confirmed 0.14.6 was current before pinning.
Official tonic docs for the current 0.14.x crate, purpose, feature surface, and latest version metadata.
Official protoc-bin-vendored docs for using a packaged protoc binary instead of relying on mutable host installation.

facets.F1_simplicity: A single generated adapter crate owns tonic/prost bindings; existing domain/API/usecase/app crates remain framework-free and continue using typed internal requests and receipts.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Vendored protoc and pinned generator/runtime dependencies make proto binding generation reproducible in local and CI environments before runtime service adapters are introduced.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests encode and decode generated request messages for messenger, mail/DMARC, social/story/collab, and all community write RPC families to catch schema/codegen drift.
facets.F4_api_contract: The adapter exposes generated modules for oya.messenger.v1, oya.mail.v1, oya.social.v1, and oya.community.v1 plus stable fully qualified method constants for runtime adapters.
facets.F5_quality: Focused generated-adapter tests plus the 44-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: GitHub Actions and Jenkins matrices now include generated binding compilation so future proto contract changes fail before runtime deployment when generated stubs drift.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Generated types carry reference IDs and encrypted-envelope metadata only in tests; no raw content bodies, credentials, broker URLs, database URLs, or principal secrets are introduced.
facets.F8_supply_chain: New direct dependencies are pinned in workspace dependencies and documented in dependency-rationales as adapter/build-script-only seams: prost, tonic, tonic-prost, tonic-prost-build, and protoc-bin-vendored.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for 5 generated-adapter unit tests and the broad backbone matrix passed 279 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: Static CI definitions include the generated adapter in all four service package matrices; this does not claim remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: Fully qualified method constants preserve method names future gRPC interceptors and trace/metric labels must bind to.
facets.F13_reversibility: The generated binding seam is isolated to one adapter crate plus dependency/catalog/CI/task/evidence wiring; reverting removes codegen without changing business logic.
